name: @comchatx/cx-amazon-stock-playbook
description: Shows where your Amazon stock is, and when to restock.
author: ComChatX

comchatx.name: Amazon Stock Playbook
comchatx.about: 看清亚马逊库存都在哪，算出何时补货、补多少。

stock-position.zh: 查清库存在哪、处于什么状态、能卖多少。
stock-position.en: Where your stock is, its state, and what can sell now.

stock-cost.zh: 算出仓储、库龄等压库存的费用。
stock-cost.en: What holding stock costs: storage, aged stock and more.

stock-out.zh: 分析断货的影响和被低估的需求。
stock-out.en: What a stock-out stops, and the demand it hides.

restock.zh: 读懂补货建议，算出发多少、何时发。
restock.en: Amazon's restock advice, and how much to send when.

stock-inbound.zh: 跟踪在途库存，查收货短缺和入库费用。
stock-inbound.en: Stock on its way: when it sells, shortfalls and fees.

stuck-stock.zh: 找出卡住的库存，以及每条出路的代价。
stuck-stock.en: Stuck stock, and what each way out costs.

fbm-and-channels.zh: 管理自发货数量、多渠道配送和站外库存。
fbm-and-channels.en: Your own-fulfilled quantity, MCF and stock elsewhere.

stock-position.zh: 盘点亚马逊库存：在哪、能卖多少、哪些卡住了。

restock-plan.zh: 看看哪些商品该补货，发多少、何时发。

stock-cost.zh: 算出上个月在亚马逊压库存花了多少钱。

stuck-stock.zh: 找出滞留、冗余、超龄和不可售的库存及其出路。

stockout-review.zh: 复盘最近的断货：断了多久、为什么断。
